title: €489 million proposed to help Portugal, Spain, Italy and Malta recover from severe storms
content: The European Commission has proposed to mobilise €489 million to help Portugal, Spain, Italy and Malta recover from severe storms and flooding in January and February 2026. The funding will support recovery operations to rebuild transport infrastructure and reestablish essential services.

title: Reform of EU customs code and e-commerce rules gets green light
content: The European Parliament has approved a major reform of the EU Customs Code that introduces stricter rules for e-commerce and establishes a new customs authority in Lille. By November 2026 a new handling fee for goods ordered directly from non-EU countries will come into effect.

title: State of the Union: “Europe has chosen to forge its own path”
content: In her 2026 State of the Union speech, European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen shared the key priorities and flagship projects for the EU in the year to come. These include competitiveness and jobs, security and defence, climate resilience, social inclusion and democracy and rule of law.

title: Parliament proposes ways to bolster EU democracy against foreign interference
content: Members of the European Parliament have warned that foreign interference threats are an attack on the “very essence of the European project”, with citizens as primary victims. They adopted a report proposing practical recommendations on how the EU can do more to defend its democratic institutions.

title: Guaranteeing social rights for workers everywhere in the EU
content: The Commission has adopted proposals that will guarantee social rights for workers, regardless of where they choose to live in the EU. Workers will be able to have their professional skills understood everywhere in the EU and prove and claim their social security and health insurance rights.

title: Realising the potential of the EU’s outermost regions
content: A new Commission strategy will ensure that the EU’s outermost regions can fully realise their potential, with stronger support, greater resilience and fairer opportunities for their people. From Martinique to Madeira, the EU’s outermost regions play a key geostrategic role in today’s changing world.

title: The EU’s plan to grow innovation in Europe
content: The Commission has proposed a new European innovation act to help Europe's most innovative ideas be developed, financed and scaled up in Europe. The proposal will help innovative companies access financing and establish a common approach for research and development procurement.

title: Six of the world’s 16 major emitters reduced their emissions in 2025
content: Although greenhouse gas emissions reached a record high in 2025, six of the 16 major emitters, contributing over 1% of global emissions, achieved reductions, including Australia, Brazil and Japan. The EU cut its greenhouse gas emissions by 0.2% relative to 2024, while US emissions rose by +2.2%.

title: Science on the go: 10 EU-funded podcasts, from AI to climate change
content: Are you curious about science? Give these 10 podcasts by EU-funded researchers a listen to expand your knowledge about research into AI, climate change, food fraud and citizen science, among others. This autumn, why not learn something new, whether at home, in the office or on your commute.

title: EU reaffirms solidarity with Ukraine on 35th anniversary of regained independence
content: On 24 August, we celebrate Ukraine’s Independence Day. This occasion embodies the bravery, resistance and resilience of the Ukrainian people in the face of Russia’s vicious war of aggression. To mark the occasion, the EU Commission unfurled the Ukraine flag in front of the Berlaymont building.

title: World humanitarian day: EU answering to growing global humanitarian needs
content: August 19 marks World Humanitarian Day, an opportunity to celebrate the indispensable and tireless life-saving efforts of aid workers worldwide. Find out how the EU helps to protect local aid workers around the globe and makes sure humanitarian aid is delivered fast and effectively to those in need.
